description: This file implements the registration logic for new users in an ASP.NET Core Razor Pages web application. It handles user input validation, user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in processes.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: A Razor PageModel class responsible for handling user registration, including validation, creation, email confirmation, and sign-in.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: A nested class within RegisterModel representing the user input fields for registration: email, password, and confirm password.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the registration page, setting the return URL if provided.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for registration, validating input, creating a new user, sending email confirmation, and signing in the user.
